author_bio:
Lohit Matani is an Indian Police Service (IPS) officer of the 2014 batch posted in the Maharashtra cadre. He has done B.Tech and M.Tech in Material Science and Technology from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Varanasi. He has also done LLB from Maharashtra and is currently pursuing a Ph.D. in Cyber Crime from National Law University, Nagpur.
Before this book, he has authored three more books- (1) Internal Security, (2) Introduction to Civil Services, (3) Public Administration and Public Policy (Volume II) with OakBridge. Lohit loves interacting with the young students and candidates preparing for the civil services examination through his articles, blogs, and books. He is a writer of the blog “lohitmatani.wordpress.com”.
subject: Academic
description:
Public Administration and Public Policy (Volume I) is specially aimed at the aspirants of the Civil Services (Main) Examination. It will also be useful for the aspirants of various state services examinations.
This book is strictly aligned with the syllabus of Public Administration prescribed by UPSC. Going along the line of the syllabus, the book deals with the various aspects of administrative and organisational management and incorporates the thoughts and philosophies of various administrative scholars. Based on the evolution and scope of public administration, the book delves deep into the various paradigms and facets of public administration. In line with the UPSC syllabus, the text includes topics such as administrative thinkers, administrative laws, development administration, accountability and control, and financial management. To facilitate quick assessment, each chapter is followed by a detailed compilation of relevant questions from previous years, as well as practice questions and exercises.
The book includes flowcharts, diagrams, and mind maps to facilitate understanding and retention of concepts. Written in extremely clear and simple language, the book serves as a comprehensive textbook for Paper 1 in Public Administration.
Key Features
•	Provides chapter-by-chapter practise questions for self-assessment.
•	Guide with answers to questions asked over the last 34 years.
•	Contains a trend analysis of assignments over the last few years (2012 to 2022)

title: General Studies Series Part 5 -Indian Economy and Socio-Economic Developments
author: OakBridge
author_bio: OakBridge
subject: Academic
description:
General Studies Series Part 5 – Indian Economy and Socio- Economic Developments has been written for the aspirants of Civil Services Examination. It will also help the students in the preparation of various state services examinations.
Starting from the basic concepts of economics, the book covers various aspects of Indian economy. It delves deep into the various facets of the economy including money market, capital market, fund regulators, planning and foreign exchange. The book also deals with latest developments in the domain of Indian economy. At the end of the book, practice questions, based on the latest pattern of UPSC, have been provided for the purpose of self-assessment.
Key features
•	Latest updates on Union Budget 2023–24 and Economic Survey 2022–23
•	Comprehensive coverage of the Concepts of Economy, Food Security & Food Management and Health and Education
•	Provides solved questions of the previous years’ preliminary examinations from the year 2011 to 2022.
•	Presents 120 practice MCQs for self-assessment.
•	• Provides trend analysis of the Civil Services Preliminary Examination 2020–2022

title: NCERT-India and World Geography
author: Dr Zubairul Islam
author_bio:
Dr Zubairul Islam is an Associate Professor in the Department of Geography and Environmental Management at the University of Abuja in Nigeria. He has over 20 years of teaching and research experience, focusing on GIS and remote sensing-based research and projects. He holds a PhD in Geography and GIS Analysis from M.J.P. Rohilkhand University, India.
In addition to his academic work, Dr. Islam has industrial experience in 3D analysis of drone data and urban planning and has worked as GIS expert for Adigrat Structure Plan. He has also guided PhD students on various topics related to resource management, population dynamics, and land use and land cover change at the village level in Bareilly district.
subject: Academic
description:
The NCERT India and World Geography series from OakBridge Publishing comprehensively. covers NCERT Old+ NEW (Class 6-12) and serves as a valuable resource for students preparing for civil services examinations in particular and other examinations in general. It provides selective, systematic, and organised insights into the geographical dimensions of India and the world.
The book consists of three parts - the first dealing with the physical and human aspects of Indian geography; the second with a deeper understanding of the origins of the earth, its geological structure and the dynamic forces that shape its surface; the third dealing with the composition of the human population, examining factors such as age, gender, ethnicity, and migration.
We hope that this book will serve as a springboard to a broader perspective of geography and inspire readers to prepare for various examinations.

title: Rising Relevance of Quality Control and Bureau of Indian Standards
author: Himanshu Tewari
author_bio:
Himanshu Tewari is a respected professional with thirty years of assorted work experience. He is a Partner with KPMG in India and leads its Trade & Customs Services practice. He focuses on international trade transactions in the global value chain and its interplay with business metrices – market access, market share, revenue, cost optimization and margin governance. Himanshu is a graduate from Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur. Himanshu is deeply engaged in discussion around India Trade Policy 2.0 - post 2023, and its impact on global businesses. As the Indian economy marches towards its US$ 10 trillion ambition, this book is a humble effort in picking a topic, which is an important building block of India’s Trade Policy 2.0. The author hopes that this book will be of help to global businesses interested in engaging with India’s economic
growth story.
subject: Law
description:
An easy-to-read and understandable collection that touches on essential parts of BIS quality control regulation in India and its interplay with the way of doing business in India.
It provides a roadmap for companies looking to engage with India’s high quality
licensing framework.
The book connects the dots of practical advice to create an easy-to-follow picture while encouraging action and flow in the midst of analysis.

title: Social Justice
author: Naveen Kumar Chandra, IAS
author_bio:
Naveen Kumar Chandra is an avid reader and prolific writer. He is also very interested in subjects and topics such as economics, philosophy, psychology, physics, astronomy, music and art. He also
loves to paint and sketch. He writes on a variety of issues and topics and has published several books. He has a blog which he has been writing for over 10 years. Having graduated from IIT Roorkee, he is currently working as an IAS officer in the state of West Bengal.
subject: Academic
description:
Social Justice is a comprehensive understanding of the subject, with particular attention to its relevance to the examination UPSC CSE. The book covers various aspects of social justice in India, including historical perspectives, emerging issues, policy frameworks and the role of public service in promoting social justice.

The book draws on a wide range of sources including academic literature, government reports and case studies to provide a nuanced and critical analysis of social justice in India. It aims to provide aspirants for the UPSC CSE examination with an in-depth understanding of the subject, which is essential for addressing social justice issues in the examination.

Through this book, we hope to contribute to the ongoing discourse on social justice in India and inspire a generation of civil service aspirants who are committed to equality, fairness, and justice in society.

Features
•	Well-researched book based on academic literature, government reports and case studies.
•	Inclusion of planners and strategies for GS paper II -Social Justice
•	Provides appendices of Global Indices and Ranking
•	Questions from previous years (2022-2013): UPSC Mains (GS paper II -Social Justice)

title: Indian Geography Through Maps
author: Somesh Upadhyay, IAS
author_bio:
Somesh Kumar Upadhyay is an Indian administrative service officer of 2017 batch currently serving as the Collector & DM of Deogarh district in Odisha. He has a master’s in biology (by Research) degree from the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Mumbai along with UGC-NET and BSc (Hons) Microbiology degree from St. Xavier’s College, Kolkata.
Geography has been his most favourite subject since school and that is what motivated him to choose the optional in the UPSC CSE 2016 where he held AIR 34.
subject: Academic
description:
Indian Geography Through Maps is a comprehensive text specifically aimed for the aspirants of Civil Services examination. It will also be useful for those appearing in various State Services examinations.
The book will help the aspirants to discover the vibrant tapestry of India's geography as embark on a captivating journey through maps. The figures and data used in the book are the latest figures from government sources. In addition, the maps have been updated and illustrated for clarity.
This book is a first-of-its-kind attempt to provide a single book with brevity and simplicity that ease the Civil Services preparation journey of aspirants.
Key Features
•	With More than 100 Maps and Diagrams
•	Solved Previous Years Papers of Prelims (2014-2023)
•	Unsolved Previous Years Papers of Geography Optional and GS 1 (2014-2022)
•	Updated data and figures

title: Practical Guide to Drafting Commercial Contracts 3/e
author: Bhumesh Verma
author_bio: Bhumesh Verma is the Managing Partner of Corp Comm Legal, an independent Indian law firm headquartered in New Delhi. Besides, he is the convenor of Global Business Lawyers’ League and The Indian Lawyers’ League. With over 25 years’ experience, he is one of the leading Indian senior corporate practitioners ranked inter alia in the ‘A List’ of the Top 100 Indian Lawyers by India Business Law Journal from time to time, most Admired Indian Lawyers, most followed Indian lawyers on LinkedIn, etc. An avid reader, a sought-after speaker, guest faculty and prolific writer, he has contributed to in-house journals of many international law firms on Indian laws and published more than 400 articles so far.
subject: Law
description: Practical Guide to Drafting Commercial Contracts is a concise handbook enumerating the key aspects pertaining to drafting effective commercial agreements. Written in a lucid language, the author explains the factors that a draftsman must consider while drafting an agreement that clearly reflects the intent of the parties. A carefully drafted contract must be precise, comprehensive, devoid of contradictions, grammatically accurate and amenable to clear legal interpretation in case of disputes arising therefrom. Contract drafting is a crucial skill that every lawyer must acquire and hone. With the intent to expand the scope of discussion on the various facets of contract negotiation and drafting, especially in this technology driven era, the second edition includes new chapters on e-contracts, damages, intellectual property rights and negotiation. The book also provides specimen drafts of contracts for key commercial transactions for ease of reference by readers. The book will be useful for lawyers, law students and non-lawyers.Bhumesh Verma is the Managing Partner of Corp Comm Legal, an independent Indian law firm headquartered in New Delhi. Besides, he is the convenor of Global Business Lawyers’ League and The Indian Lawyers’ League. With over 25 years’ experience, he is one of the leading Indian senior corporate practitioners ranked inter alia in the ‘A List’ of the Top 100 Indian Lawyers by India Business Law Journal from time to time, most Admired Indian Lawyers, most followed Indian lawyers on LinkedIn, etc. An avid reader, a sought-after speaker, guest faculty and prolific writer, he has contributed to in-house journals of many international law firms on Indian laws and published more than 400 articles so far.

title: Science and Technology – From Inception to Advancement
author: Neeraj Nachiketa
author_bio: Neeraj Nachiketa is a trained Biotechnologist from IIT Bombay and also an alumnus of National Law School, Bengaluru. He is one of the most popular and sought after faculty member and has been guiding aspirants of the Civil Services Examination all over the country on Science and Technology for the past 17 years. Many of his students have qualified with top ranks and are serving in various capacities in the Government of India. He is also a member of the Bar Council of India and a practicing advocate in IPR. He has worked in corporates in various capacities in Bio-Medical field before joining the Bar Council as a Patent Law practitioner. He has pursued M.A. in Security and Defence law from NALSAR, Hyderabad.
subject: Academic
description: Science and Technology - from Inception to Advancement, Third Edition is an authoritative and most updated book written for the aspirants of Civil Services Preliminary and Main Examinations. This book will also be useful for various state services examinations. Starting with the fundamentals of science and technology infrastructure in India, the book delves deep into the concepts and applications of technologies related to various areas like nuclear, space and defence among others. It provides a detailed insights on the new age technologies like Recombinant DNA Technology, Nanotechnology, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Blockchain, Cryptocurrencies, Internet of Things, Hyperloop, Electric Vehicles, Driverless cars, Robotics etc. While dealing with the scientific aspects of Covid-19, the book discusses the evolution of medical infrastructure during the time of pandemic. Dedicated chapters on agricultural technologies (hydroponics, aquaponics, bio-farming) and earth sciences have been provided for illustrating the change that technology can bring in a sector that employs majority of the Indian population. Diagrams and flowcharts have been used for better understanding.

title: ESM English Studies Manual
author: Ap Bhardwaj
author_bio: A P BHARDWAJ enjoys the stature and distinction of being the author of #1 NATIONAL BEST SELLER COMPULSORY ENGLISH for IAS (MAINS) for more than one decade. He is a brand name for his best-selling books LA/LR & Legal Aptitude Workbook for CLAT, SLAT, AILET, PU, DU, BHU & other Law Entrance Exams. He has the credit of enabling an umpteen number of students to enter National Law Universities and is known as CLAT GURU. He has been in the publishing field for the last 16 years and is the author of more than a dozen popular titles with nationally and internationally acclaimed publishers. He is popular in the tri-city of Chandigarh-Mohalli-Panchkula as an ELT expert. He is a highly sought-after trainer on YouTube.
subject: Academic
description:
ESM (English Studies Manual) traces the increasing role and importance of the English language with changed patterns of CLAT & AILET.

ESM is meticulously designed study material to enable the students to face new challenges. It is a clear, compact, and comprehensive book to enable students to prepare for the English section of Law Entrance Exams quickly and confidently.


•	6-in-1 Book
•	6 Parts, 25 Chapters, 300 PTs, 3000 MCQs
•	Complete Coverage of Vocabulary, English Usage, Grammar, Figures of speech, Comprehension, and Solved English section of CLAT/AILET (2021-2023)

title: At the Intersection of Law & Life Essays in Honour of Justice MN Venkatachaliah
author: Bibek Debroy and Sameer Kochhar
author_bio:
Bibek Debroy is the Chairman of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister, Government of India.

Sameer Kochhar, Chairman of SKOCH Group, is a reform historian and author of the best-seller ModiNomics. He is an expert on governance and inclusive growth.
subject: Law
description:
A rich collection of essays by eminent personalities on Justice MN Venkatachaliah, the Judge, and the individual. Justice Manepali Narayanarao Venkatachaliah's diverse roles as a Judge in various courts, Chief Justice of India, Chairman of the National Human Rights Commission, Chairman of the Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution, and other positions are covered in the book.

Right from his days at the highest judiciary to his simple superannuated yet emeritus status, Justice Venkatachaliah has preached reforms for efficiency.

The topics include:

Human rights
Tax law
Public Policy
Alternative Dispute Resolution
Arbitration law, energy-related arbitration, and his pro-arbitration approach.
Other topics, like education and the selection of judges, are briefly touched upon. The contributors reflect on his journey from pre-Independent India to witnessing the nation's transformation.

title: MPPSC Mains Examination Series General Studies Paper 2 Vol I
author: Sagar Srivastava
author_bio: Sagar Srivastava is a Range Forest Officer with the Madhya Pradesh Government. Previously he has worked as Assistant System Engineer with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) after completing his Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communication. He has also been mentoring state services aspirants at various coaching institutes.
subject: Academic
description:
MPPPSC General Studies Paper 2, Volume I is a comprehensive guidebook for aspirants of the MPPSC examination. It covers all the topics in Units 1 to 5 under Constitution, Governance, Political and Administrative Structure of MPPPSC General Studies Paper 2 as prescribed by the New MPPSC syllabus in a lucid manner with the help of diagrams and flowcharts. It also provides detailed insights on Constitution, Governance, Political and Administrative Structure; Accountability and Rights; Indian Political Thinkers; Administration and Management

Key features

Strictly mapped word by word according to the New Syllabus of MPPSC
Contains all the topics in Units 1 to 5 under Constitution, Governance, Political
and Administrative Structure of MPPPSC General Studies Paper 2
Contains Unique Charts and Diagrams, which will help aspirants in scoring better
Presents the content in a concise form ensuring that every statement in the book is meaningful and important
Provides Solved Previous Year Papers of MPPSC GS Paper 2.

title: Disaster Management
author: P Kumar
author_bio: P. Kumar is a core geographer. He completed his undergraduate, Master of Arts and Master of Philosophy degrees from the Department of Geography, Delhi School of Economics, University of Delhi. He teaches as an Assistant Professor (adhoc) at Swami Shraddhanand University, Delhi University. He has also been a visiting lecturer for Civil Services Academy at Pandit Deen Dayal Petroleum University, Gandhinagar, Sr. Lecturer at Srichaitanya Degree University, Hyderabad, and Lecturer in Geography at reputed coaching institutions.
subject: Academic
description:
Disaster Management has been written for providing insights on various types of disasters and the ways to manage them. It is useful for the aspirants of Civil Services and various State services Examinations. The book begins with an introduction to the subject of disasters and provides information on the different types of natural and man-made disasters. It also covers in detail the various approaches and aspects of disaster management, mitigation techniques, disaster preparedness, capacity building and the role of various stakeholders in disaster management. It also provides information on the various institutions and organisations involved in disaster management.

The book has 27 chapters, with each chapter covering the different aspects of disasters and their management. Flowcharts, maps, diagrams and tables have been used for better understanding.

Key Features -

Questions from previous years for the main exam
Multidisciplinary approach and linkage with Environment and Geography
Presentation of flowcharts, maps, diagrams, and tables
Covers international cooperation in disaster management.
Comprehensive coverage of natural and Man-made Disasters like Train Accidents and Disaster Response.

title: CSAT: Practice Papers
author: Sudhanshu Kumar
author_bio: Sudhanshu Kumar is associated with several premier Civil Services coaching institutes in Delhi, Bhubaneshwar, Bengaluru, and Patna. He holds Graduate and Post Graduate degrees in Computer Science from Delhi. He has been guiding aspirants of Civil Services examination for over a decade.
subject: Academic
description:
CSAT Previous Years' Solved & Practice Papers is a book written for the aspirants of Civil Services Examination. It will also help aspirants in various state services examinations.

The book contains solved practice papers and previous years’ UPSC questions on CSAT. It has been designed in a new learning style and special care has been taken to provide clarity on the concepts relating to complex questions. The book is the outcome of classroom experience of the author, and it seeks to educate the readers about various aspects of the subject in a simple and lucid manner. A unique feature of time-bound Live Online test has been provided for the aspirants.

The book will act as a comprehensive practice workbook for the aspirants, as it includes questions based on the latest pattern of CSAT.

Key Features -

Comprises of 8 practice sets of CSAT with solutions.
Includes solutions to the previous years’ UPSC questions on CSAT from the year 2011 to 2023
Incorporates access to time-bound Live Online test for the purpose of self-assessment.
Explains smart techniques for solving complex questions.

title: The Good Divorce It’s Not What You Think A Memoir
author: Sarita Salwan
author_bio:
Sarita Salwan author spent her schooling years in Dalhousie and pursued her MA in Human Resources and Marketing from a private management institute in Delhi. Sarita has successfully organised events, and introduced well-known Indian stand-up comedians, including Amit Tandon, to Oslo’s audiences.She loves learning tarot, sipping chai with her teenage daughter and gossiping, just a bit. The Good Divorce: It’s Not What you Think is her debut book.

Connect with the author on Instagram: @sarita__salwan
subject: Business & General
description:
If she wasn't beaten up, her partner was not lying or cheating, why does a woman want divorce?

For more than a decade, Sarita Salwan häs stayed loyal to her clients, committed to finding the quickest and most relevant solution whenever they need. For more than a decade, Sarita has also stayed committed to her family, ensuring her daughter has a room of her own, and the best of opportunities. That's Sarita, a 43-year-old divorced woman, who decided to separate from her partner after almost 10 years of being married. So,

'Does she live alone now?'

'Her husband did not pay alimony?'

'Who pays all the bills?'

In this atypical memoir, Sarita Salwan, travel agent-cum-DJ, born and brought up in India and Norway, will tell you not what led to the divorce but how she came of age. From a 23-year-old Bollywood loving Punjabi girl who believed that taking off her red bangles or choora before a year of marriage was a sign of bad luck, to the woman who believes if nothing works out, divorce should be seen as an option.

Although she is not a cold-hearted person, she certainly feels good about doing things her way, and doesn't feel guilty afterwards.

title: Indian Polity & Governance (Updated Edition)
author: Nirbhay Sharma
author_bio: Nirbhay Sharma is an established advocate of the Supreme Court. After pursuing LLB from Campus Law Centre, University of Delhi, he completed his Master in Business Laws from NLSIU, Bangalore and LLM from Kurukshetra University. He underwent a General Course in Intellectual Property conducted bya the World Intellectual Property Organisation, Geneva. He has been passionately guiding aspirants of Civil Services as well as Judicial Services examinations for the past 15 years.
subject: Academic
description:
Indian Polity and Governance is a significant book written specifically for Civil Services aspirants. This brilliantly researched and exceptionally detailed book will also be critical while preparing for various state services examinations. The content, form and structure of the book has been designed in a manner that it can even help students preparing for optional subjects like Law, Political Science and Public Administration, while being of equal significance and relevance to those preparing for Judiciary, CLAT and other Law Entrance Tests. Starting from the history of evolution of the Indian Constitution, the book delves deep into the salient features of the Constitution, the different organs of the government and their respective role in India’s political system, and the functions of constitutional and non-constitutional bodies among others.

Key Features -

Provides strategy to study and prepare the Indian Polity for UPSC.
Provides tables of important articles, schedules, and amendments in the Indian Constitution.
Features solved papers of UPSC Prelims from the year 2011 to 202 & Indian Polity asked in papers of UPSC Mains examination from the year 2013 to 2023.
Embedded with smart code for online support
Provides 10 online mock-tests for self-assessment.

title: The Law of Goods and Services Tax A Comprehensive Commentary
author: Ramakrishnan Viraraghavan
author_bio: Ramakrishnan Viraraghavan is a Barrister and Senior Advocate based in New Delhi, practising at the Supreme Court of India. He is a tenant in Chambers at 33 Bedford Row and has rights of audience before the Royal Courts of Justice in England and Wales. He carries nearly four decades of experience in taxation and commercial litigation. He has appeared before almost every tier of taxation authorities from the Commissioner to the Supreme Court of India, at various stages of his career.
subject: Tax
description:
A detailed section-wise internet age commentary on the CGST Act, IGST Act and GST (Compensation to States) Act.
First commentary on GST written by a Senior Advocate practising at the Supreme Court distilling his vast experience of nearly four decades of litigation practice.
Designed to give quick answers to busy GST adjudicators and GST practitioners without wading through judgements and circulars.
A focused and penetrative commentary based on judgements of the courts and rulings of advance ruling authorities. The relevant pages and paragraphs of the relevant judgements and circulars are referred only in the footnotes.
Vexed issues of classification are dealt in a separate chapter with goods and services arranged alphabetically under their common names. The commentary guides the reader on issues not yet decided by the Supreme Court or the High Courts.
The book incorporates the amendments made by the Finance Act, 2023, the CGST (Amendment) Act, 2023 and the IGST (Amendment) Act 2023. Taxation of supplies in casinos, racecourses and online gaming has been addressed in a separate chapter. Relevant decisions reported in GSTR up to 31 July 2023 have been added in the book.

title: Reforms in Tax Administration An Indian Experience
author: Pratap Singh, IRS
author_bio: Pratap Singh, is an IRS officer, having rich experience in tax policy formulation and administration of over last 30 years. He has handled various important assignments in the Government all over the country. He has written two research papers besides chairing some committees and authoring several reports. Several amendments in the Income Tax Act 1961 were carried out on the basis of notes submitted by him. He writes regular columns in Taxindiaonline and other important magazines. The author holds M.Tech from IIT Kanpur and PhD in Economics from Mysore University, besides holding LLB and MBA (PGDM), where he topped the university.
subject: Tax
description:
The book is the result of five years of extensive research, aiming to analyse India's tax system and its administration. The focus is on evaluating tax reforms, particularly those of the last 30 years, and their effects on tax collection, the Tax-GDP ratio, the tax base, and the overall economy. The study explores the relationship between tax and GDP growth, scrutinises the impact of significant 1991 tax reforms on subsequent tax collection, and compares India's tax-GDP ratio with other nations.

Additionally, it investigates the aftermath of the 2008 global economic crisis on taxes, discusses anti-tax evasion measures, and introduces the Tax Administration Diagnostic Assessment Tool Model (TADAT) for assessing tax administration efficiency. The book offers recommendations for improving tax administration and highlights the delayed effects of the 1991 reforms on tax collection and the impact of the 2008 slowdown. It is a valuable resource for researchers, tax professionals, administrators, and economics students.

title: Reform & Deform A Five-Side Critique of GST
author: Rav Pratap Singh
author_bio: Rav Pratap Singh is an Associate Professor of Legal Practice at OP Jindal Global University, Sonipat. He is a generalist economic lawyer with a variety of specialist interests. He has active interests in Goods and Services Tax, Corporate Tax, Tax and Financial Dimensions of the Constitution. He also provides consultancy to select clients on non-litigation issues concerning tax matters, economic laws, and succession planning.
subject: Tax
description:
Reform and Deform: A Five-Side Critique of GST takes stock of the initial five and a half years of GST since its implementation in July 2017.

This book focuses on five separate but inter-related aspects of GST: concept of supply, claims of input tax credit (‘ITC’), jurisprudence on arrests and attachment, dysfunctional dispute resolution framework and sub-par advance ruling mechanism, and a dedicated chapter containing detailed critique of the GST’s anti-profiteering mechanism.

All five aspects are examined to underline the central argument made in the book, i.e., GST is a reform is increasingly being deformed due to poorly reasoned judicial opinions, sub-par advance rulings and uncertainty produced by reactive and ad hoc executive responses.

Reform and Deform is a trailblazer as it presents a structured analysis of GST by deploying a jargon-free and straightforward vocabulary. It examines several legal developments in detail, places them in proper historical context and views GST not as an end in itself but a milestone in India’s continuing journey towards an improved indirect tax regime.

title: Capital Gains Tax Law and Practice
author: TG Suresh
author_bio: T G Suresh, Senior Partner of Suresh & Balaji, Chartered Accountants, has over 34 years of experience in direct tax, international tax, and foreign exchange laws. He is a faculty member at Maruti Coaching in Chennai and a visiting faculty member at professional organizations like ICAI, ICSI, and ICMAI. Suresh is also the Chairman of the International Fiscal Association – Southern Regional Chapter and the Direct Tax Task Force of the South Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
subject: Tax
description:
Capital Gains Tax – Law and Practice comprehensively covers legal and practical aspects governing the taxation of short-term and long-term capital gains as provided under Chapter IV(E) of the Income-Tax Act, 1961. The sixth edition has been thoroughly revised and updated in view of amendments brought in by the Finance Act,2023.

Key Features -

Written in a simple and lucid language.
Practical scenarios and illustrations discussed for better understanding.
Judicial pronouncements have been examined and mentioned as appropriate.
Incorporates all relevant Notifications, Circulars and Schemes up to 30th June 2023
All relevant circulars and notifications have been reproduced under the appendices.
Detailed analysis of capital gains relating to shares, securities, and Business Restructuring transactions.
Provisions relating to Real estate transactions (including JDA) are covered extensively.
Apex Court decisions/interpretations are appropriately highlighted and considered.
Provisions relating to international transactions and Non-residents are covered comprehensively.
Appropriate suggestions provided on Controversial provisions to reduce/avoid litigation.

title: Technology and Analytics for Law & Justice
author: Nomesh Bhojkumar Bolia and Surya Prakash BS
author_bio: The DAKSH Centre of Excellence for Law and Technology at IIT Delhi conducts interdisciplinary research to explore and understand various aspects of the justice system. It brings together lawyers, researchers, scientists and policy analysts to build solutions for the biggest challenges facing the justice system, drawing from fields such as operations research, data analytics, technology and law. As an interdisciplinary centre harnessing the strengths and experience of IIT Delhi and DAKSH, the DAKSH Centre of Excellence for Law and Technology leverages rigorous research to produce a real-world impact on the functioning of the justice system.
subject: Law
description: This unique volume from the DAKSH Centre of Excellence for Law and Technology examines the evolution of technology in the law and justice system in India. It delves into the challenges and opportunities presented by technology, current thinking on the subject, and what the future may hold for this rapidly developing field. From tracing the historical journey of law and technology in India to the rise of 'justicemakers,' the impact of cutting-edge forensic technology, the world of smart contracts, and the realm of surveillance, this book offers a comprehensive and thought-provoking look at the ever-changing landscape of law and technology. This book will be of interest to a wide audience, including researchers, policymakers, government agencies, technologists, law firms, legal practitioners, academics, and students looking for a head-start in the world of transforming law and justice systems.

title: The Definitive Guide to UPSC Success: Crafting Your IAS Journey
author: Shabbir A Bashir and Deb Tripathi
author_bio:
Shabbir A Bashir, a renowned UPSC preparation trainer with over 21 years of experience, has a deep understanding of geography and environment. He co-founded Edukemy to make teaching and learning more engaging and effective, aiming to democratize education and reach all, regardless of location or socioeconomic status. Bashir holds a Civil Engineering degree and is certified in management and leadership skills by INSEAD (ILPSE).

Deb Tripathi is an innovative technology leader with over 24-years of expertise in Technology Architecture, Digital Transformation, Software Engineering, and Automation. He has led complex digital transformations for Fortune 500 companies globally and holds two US patents in integration and automation. He holds exceptional leadership experience and has been associated with Accenture as the Managing Director. He co-founded Edukemy to improve education quality and provide meaningful learning experiences to students across India.
subject: Academic
description:
Cracking UPSC, the mother of all exams, requires more than just knowledge; it demands a transformation of mindset, vision for success, and an unwavering commitment to nation-building.

‘The Definitive Guide to UPSC Success Crafting Your IAS Journey,' goes beyond conventional study techniques, delving into the realms of mindset and personality development. It is not merely a study guide; it is a holistic approach to navigating the challenges of one of the most rigorous examinations.

‘The Definitive Guide to UPSC Success Crafting Your IAS Journey' is your companion in this transformative journey. Let the wisdom within the pages guide you toward not just passing an exam, but upgrading yourself to a new version, shaping your future.

title: Treatise on Arbitration Law & Practice – A Critical Commentary on Part I of the Act of 1996 (2 Vol. Set)
author: M Sricharan Rangarajan
author_bio: Mr M Sricharan Rangarajan is a Senior Advocate of Madras High Court. With over 17 years of experience in the Bar, he has appeared in full-bench matters and has also been appointed as amicus curiae to assist the court in matters of importance, covering diverse subjects. He has acted as an Arbitrator in both domestic and international arbitrations. He was appointed as an Additional Advocate General for the State of Tamil Nadu where he handled matters in relation to Arbitration extensively, on behalf of the State.
subject: Law
description:
A section-wise practical commentary on Part I of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 with relevant case laws.
Traces the History of the Arbitration Act, covers UNCITRAL Model Laws and Law Commission reports.
Provides insights into the current legal framework, addresses challenges in arbitration, suggests amendments to enhance its efficacy in resolving commercial disputes.
A practitioner's perspective, maintaining clarity in legal interpretation and expressing ideas in accessible language.
An invaluable guide for arbitrators, practitioners, and aspiring law students interested and specialising in arbitration law and practice.

title: New Range & Orthodox Concerns in International Taxation
author: Parthasarathi Shome
author_bio: Parthasarathi Shome is Founder Chairman, ITRAF, Bengaluru, and Eminent Persons Council, Tax Notes International. He was Adviser (Minister of State) to the Indian Finance Minister, and chaired India’s Tax Administration Reform Commission (TARC). He has held various positions, including Chief Economist, UK Revenue and Customs; Chief of Tax Policy, IMF; and Professor, American University, Washington DC. His work on GAAR and retrospective taxation is widely cited. He is a recipient of Brazil’s highest civilian honour, Commander of the Order of the Southern Cross, for his contributions to Brazilian fiscal reform. He is widely published in international peer reviewed journals and books and is invited to speak across the globe.
subject: Tax
description:
New Range & Orthodox Concerns in International Taxation covers emerging issues in the various branches of international taxation, advancing International Tax Research and Analysis Foundation’s (ITRAF’s) tradition of bringing together a new range as well as orthodox concerns and presenting them to the expert.

The new range of issues includes the profound ramifications of a steady and speeding emergence of robots, the emerging new international rules for taxing carbon emissions to buttress a green transition, the conversion of the extortion of resources to a new tax collected at checkpoints in Afghanistan, and the dilemma of providing too little or too much tax incentives to attract international professional experts in Sweden. Traditional concerns such as tax avoidance, transparency, and ethics in tax planning are explored, along with issues related to Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS).

The volume contains a comprehensive foreword and the history of national tax systems in a globalised world. Overall, the collection provides a contemporary overview of international tax issues, making it a valuable resource for specialists in the field.

title: Samanya Adhyayan Paper 5 | सामान्य अध्ययन पेपर - 5
author: Kamna Singh & Vaibhav Kumar
author_bio:
कामना सिंह, वर्तमान में राज्य कर अध्किारी, उत्तर प्रदेश के पद पर नियुक्त हैं। इनका चयन उत्तर प्रदेश लोक सेवा आयोग द्वारा आयोजित पीएससी परीक्षा 2016 में हुआ। लेखिका को आईएएस एवं विभिन्न राज्यों की पीएससी परीक्षायें देने का अनुभव रहा है।

वैभव कुमार, वर्तमान में सिविल सेवा प्रशिक्षक एवं मार्गदर्शक के रूप में विभिन्न अभ्यर्थियों का मार्गदर्शन एवं निर्देशन कर रहे हैं। इन्होने आईएएस एवं विभिन्न पीएससी परीक्षाओं में प्री एवं मेन्स की परीक्षायें उत्तीर्ण की हैं तथा हिंदी साहित्य, राजनीति विज्ञान एवं समाज कार्य जैसे विषयों का गहन अध्ययन किया है तथा स्नातकोत्तर उपाध्यिाँ प्राप्त की हैं।
subject: Academic
description:
सामान्य अध्ययन पेपर-5, उत्तर प्रदेश लोक सेवा आयोग (UPPSC) द्वारा आयोजित सम्मिलित अधीनस्थ सेवा [Combined State/Upper Subordinate (Mains)] के नवीन पाठ्यक्रम पर आधारित लिखी गयी पुस्तक है।

प्रमुख विशेषताएँ -

UPPSC द्वारा जारी नवीन पाठ्यक्रम पर आधारित सरल, सुबोध् और सुगम्य भाषा में लिखी पुस्तक है।
नवीन पाठ्यक्रम में दिये गये विषयों को समसामयिक मुद्दों से अंतर्संबंध करना।
उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार के द्वारा संचालित नीतियों, योजनाओं, परियोजनाओं का यथा सम्भव स्थान पर समावेश किया
गया है।
फ्लोचार्ट, तालिकाओं, चित्रों का प्रयोग, जिन्हें उत्तर लेखन में प्रयुक्त किया जा सकता है।
यूपीपीएससी 2023 मुख् परीक्षा (सामान्य अध्ययन पेपर-5) के मॉडल उत्तर की प्रस्तुति।

title: Transforming HARYANA 9 Incredible Years of Haryana Government
author: Dr. Kuldip Chand Agnihotri
author_bio: Dr. Kuldip Chand Agnihotri, Former Vice-Chancellor, Central University of Himachal Pradesh, Dharamshala.
subject: Business & General
description:
A comprehensive compendium presenting an account of nearly a decade of work by the Manohar Lal Government.
Describes in detail, along with data, the nature of the plans, their objectives, the implementing agency, and the classes of society kept in mind while preparing the outline of the plan.
Valuable insights on the comprehensive governance strategies, innovative policies, and impactful projects that have shaped the state’s landscape.
This collection includes three types of articles:
First, articles by scholars who have been active in political life for a long time expressing their opinion on various schemes of the Haryana government.
Second, articles by officers working or who have worked in various positions in the state’s executive regarding the implementation of these schemes.
Third, articles by scholars working in the academic field explaining the long-term impacts of these schemes.

title: हरियाणा सरकार के 9 अतुलनीय वर्ष एक नए एवं जीवंत हरियाणा का उदय
author: प्रोफेसर कुलदीप चन्द अग्निहोत्री
author_bio: डॉ. कुलदीप चंद अग्निहोत्री, पूर्व कुलपति, हिमाचल प्रदेश केंद्रीय विश्वविद्यालय, धर्मशाला|
subject: Business & General
description:
मनोहर लाल सरकार के लगभग एक दशक के कामकाज का लेखा-जोखा प्रस्तुत करने वाला एक व्यापक सार-संग्रह।
डेटा के साथ-साथ योजनाओं की प्रकृति, उनके उद्देश्य, कार्यान्वयन एजेंसी और योजना की रूपरेखा तैयार करते समय ध्यान में रखे जाने वाले समाज के वर्गों का भी विस्तार से वर्णन करता है।
व्यापक शासन रणनीतियों, नवीन नीतियों और प्रभावशाली परियोजनाओं पर मूल्यवान अंतर्दृष्टि, जिन्होंने राज्य के परिदृश्य को आकार दिया है।
इस संग्रह में तीन प्रकार के लेख शामिल हैं:
सबसे पहले, लंबे समय से राजनीतिक जीवन में सक्रिय रहे विद्वानों के लेख, जो हरियाणा सरकार की विभिन्न योजनाओं पर अपनी राय व्यक्त करते हैं।
दूसरा, इन योजनाओं के कार्यान्वयन के संबंध में राज्य की कार्यकारिणी में विभिन्न पदों पर कार्यरत या काम कर चुके अधिकारियों के लेख।
तीसरा, शैक्षणिक क्षेत्र में काम करने वाले विद्वानों के लेख जो इन योजनाओं के दीर्घकालिक प्रभावों को समझाते हैं।

title: Double Taxation Treaties - Concepts, Practices & Trends (2 Vol. Set)
author: K R Sekar
author_bio: K R Sekar is a Partner with Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP and Leader – Domestic Market and Deloitte Private for Deloitte India. He has over three decades of experience in the fields of international taxation, transfer pricing, direct taxes and mergers and acquisitions. He is also associated with several landmark litigations relating to global companies. He was recognised as one of India's leading tax advisers in Legal Media Group's Guide to the World's Leading Tax Advisers, Euromoney and International Tax Review. He has served as the President of the Bangalore Chamber of Industry & Commerce and is the Governing Member of the International Tax Research and Analysis Foundation (ITRAF), a dedicated research body in the field of international tax.
subject: Tax
description:
A comprehensive exploration of Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements, encompassing prevailing issues & practices as well as emerging trends.
The book considers the increasing complexities relating to digital economy and its impact on the prevailing principles and concepts under the DTAA, while explaining in detail the existing treaties and the latest judicial decisions relating to it.
The two volume set analyses Anti-Avoidance Regulations and practices under relevant provisions including Thin Cap Regulations, CFC Regulations & GAAR.
Additionally, Multilateral Instruments, Pillar 1 and Pillar 2, pertinent issues within select industries, new tax architecture trends & the relevance of OECD amid challenges posed by developing countries have been dealt with in detail.
The book will be a useful reference for tax professionals, policymakers, judicial officers, enforcement authorities, academicians & tax students.

title: Supreme Court of India: Musings, Anecdotes & Episodes
author: N Vijayaraghavan and Sharath Chandran
author_bio:
N Vijayaraghavan is a practising Advocate, Madras High Court, with over 3 decades of experience. He has authored several books like Constitution and its Making: Musings, Anecdotes and Episodes & Constitution and its Working: Musings, Anecdotes and Episodes. He has been a resource person with TN Judicial Academy, run by the Madras High Court and National Judicial Academy, Bhopal, run by the Supreme Court of India.

Sharath Chandran is an Advocate practising primarily at the Madras High Court. He completed his law from the ILS Law College, Pune and went on to read for the B.C.L from the University of Oxford. He has co-authored several books on the Constitution of India, Motor Vehicles Laws, Principles of Insurance Law, Law of Evidence et al.
subject: Law
description:
The book explains the journey of the highest court in India since its inception 75 years ago.
Offers a compelling account of the origins of the Federal Court and Constituent Assembly Debates.
It weaves together a series of thought-provoking narratives relating to appointment of judges, credibility of the judicial institution, judicial legislation, and public interest litigation.
A well-researched critique on select judgments of the Supreme Court with the intent to present an alternative perspective on the issues under discussion in these cases.
Useful for lawyers, legal academics, scholars, researchers, policy makers and interested citizens.

title: Previous Years Solved Papers- Psychology Paper-I (2015-2023)
author: OakBridge
author_bio: OakBridge
subject: Academic
description:
Previous Year’s Solved Papers-Psychology Paper I is a comprehensive text specifically aimed at the aspirants of the Civil Services Examination. It will also be useful for those appearing in various civil services examinations.

The book begins with an insight into the methodology of writing psychology answers and strategies (optional). It illustrates the use of Bloom's Taxonomy of Critical Thinking to reach at an answer or conclusion. The book contains answers for Psychology Paper I of Civil Services Examination (Main) from 2015 to 2023, and trend analysis of last three years for Psychology Paper I of Civil Services Examination (Main).

This book is a first-of-its-kind attempt to provide a single book with brevity and simplicity that ease the Civil Services preparation journey of aspirants.

Key Features

Provides solved papers of Psychology Paper I of Civil Services Main Examination
from 2015 to 2023
Insights on Answer Writing Methodology and Strategies
Illustrates the use of Bloom's Taxonomy for critical thinking
Contains trend analysis of last three years for Psychology Paper I of Civil Services
Examination (Main)
Mapped to the New Syllabus of UPSC
Embedded with Mind-Maps and Flow chart

title: MasterGuide to NTA UGC NET | SET | JRF Paper 1 (Teaching and Research Aptitude)
author: Harpreet Kaur
author_bio: Harpreet Kaur, former faculty at Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar and founding director of Egzaminer is a seasoned writer and has dedicated herself to simplifying the complexities of competitive exams, primarily NTA UGC-NET Paper-1. With a wealth of knowledge and a knack for clarity, she has perfectly mastered the art of guiding the aspiring individuals through the intricate maze of competitive exams. Through this book, get ready to embark on a transformative journey as she shares insights, strategies, and a roadmap to success in the world of competitive exams.
subject: Academic
description:
Complete Coverage of Latest Syllabus as per Exam Trends
Strategy and Tips to Crack NET Exam in First Attempt
Chapter-wise PYQs (2004-2023) for Revision & Retention
Latest 2023 Question Papers with Solutions
Tips and Tricks to Quickly Solve Questions
3800+ Questions for Practice in Online and Offline Mode
11 Free Mock Tests in Real Exam-like Interface

title: Practical Guide to Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 Law and Compliance
author: Puneet Bhasin
author_bio: Advocate Puneet Bhasin is a Pioneer in Cyber Laws, Data Privacy & Protection and Online Entertainment laws in India and the most sought-after legal practitioner in this space. She is an advisor to the Rajya Sabha Committees on various aspects of Internet laws and is the recipient of 10 National Level Awards. She is a well-known author on Cyber laws and frequently contributes articles in newspapers and online portals. She regularly features on leading news channels including BBC, CNBC, Zee News, and DD News sharing her views and recommendations.
subject: Law
description:
Discusses the importance of data protection laws in India in regulating the collection, processing and storage of personal data, particularly in light of technological advancements and the misuse of data by both domestic and foreign entities.
The book provides an in-depth understanding of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, detailing all its provisions. Additionally, it outlines the scope, exceptions and enforcement mechanisms under the Act, along with steps for compliance and penalties for non-compliance.
The book will be useful for Legal Professionals, CISOs, CIOs, Key Management functions of organisations, Data Protection Officers, Policy Makers and Government Officials, Business Executives and Entrepreneurs, Data Privacy Advocates and Activists, Data Subjects, Compliance Officers and Auditors, Technology and Cybersecurity Professionals and International Stakeholders.

title: Court Jester
author: Raju Z Moray
author_bio: An alumnus of St. Xaviers College and Government Law College, Bombay Mr. Moray is a practicing lawyer. He was enrolled as an advocate in 1985 and joined the Chambers of Advocate Michael F. Saldanha (Later judge of Bombay & Karnataka High Courts). For the past 35 years Mr. Moray has been contributing articles and poems to the various publications of the Lawyers Collective. An anthology of his ‘Court Jester’ columns for the Lawyer’s Collective magazine was published as a book ‘COURT JESTER’ to critical acclaim in 2017 and a series of 60 poems penned during the lockdown was published as ‘THE LOCKED DOWN LAWYER’ in December 2021. His highly popular ‘Adaalat Antics’ stories appear regularly on theleaflet.in web portal.
subject: Law
description: This anthology brings together Prose and Poetry which was featured on the ‘Court Jester’ page of the Lawyers Collective Magazine from 1993 to 2003. The feature was immensely entertaining and popular. Long out of print and difficult to access, there was a consistent demand over the years from its fans to collect all the pieces together and publish them as a book. These pieces can still be enjoyed with much pleasure and profit because no one ever learns from their mistakes. Ludicrous behaviour will never go out of fashion, and bloated egos still require puncturing.

title: Tales of Law & Laughter
author: Raju Z Moray
author_bio: An alumnus of St. Xaviers College and Government Law College, Bombay Mr. Moray is a practicing lawyer. He was enrolled as an advocate in 1985 and joined the Chambers of Advocate Michael F. Saldanha (Later judge of Bombay & Karnataka High Courts). subject: Law
description: This anthology brings together thirty anecdotal stories selected from the popular ‘Adaalat Antics’ series written for theleaflet.in by the author Raju Z. Moray and specially illustrated for this exclusive print edition by Farzana Cooper. Readers will enjoy a humorous view of the life of a lawyer from law college to the Bar and the Bench. These fictional pen-portraits of lawyers and judges have entertained thousands of online readers and there has been an insistent demand from readers to collect and publish this treasury of comic tales in book form. This anthology fulfills that demand.

title: New-Age Economy Taxation: An Overview of Taxation of Digital Businesses
author: CA Pushpendra Dixit
author_bio: CA Pushpendra Dixit is a taxation professional having diverse experience of over 18 years in Direct and Indirect taxation. His expertise spans a wide range of tax-related areas, including SEZ/Developer Units establishment, GST implementation, and international tax dispute resolution. His international experience includes successful representations before German tax authorities and initiatives to optimize tax efficiencies across multiple jurisdictions. He is also a visiting faculty at ICAI and NLU Delhi.
subject: Tax
description:
Analyses the complexities of taxing digital business transactions, focusing on the introduction of Digital Services Taxes (DST) to ensure fair taxation for foreign corporations operating within different market jurisdictions.
Exploring unilateral tax measures adopted globally, with a spotlight on India, the book covers taxation of digital goods, services, and online advertising. It also examines the OECD's Two-Pillar approach, addressing the allocation of taxing rights and establishing a global minimum corporate tax rate.
Further, the book advocates the inclusion of digital transactions in the tax net to level the playing field for businesses.
The book will be useful for tax professionals, financial consultants, multinational corporations, technology firms, policymakers, legal professionals, academicians & tax students.

title: General Studies Paper I-VI | Mock Test and Previous Year Papers
author: Sudhanshu Mishra & CS Nikunj Gupta
author_bio:
Sudhanshu Mishra, the author of this UPPSC exam preparation book, holds a B.A., LL.B. and an MBA. As the founder of IAS NEXT, he is characterised by more than 5,000 enrolled students, a dedicated team of more than 20 qualified teachers, more than 5 national awards and rich experience of more than 15 years.
CS Nikunj Gupta is an experienced professional with diverse academic credentials, including a Company Secretary qualification, LL.B., and an M.A. in Economics. He boasts achievements in UPPSC exams and has received the President and Governor Awards, showcasing his dedication to excellence.
subject: Academic
description:
GENERAL STUDIES PAPER I-VI Mock Test and Previous Year Papers is a comprehensive book specifically aims at the aspirants of the UPPSC (Mains) Examination.

This book serves as a valuable tool to aid your exam preparation, offering a deeper insight into the examination pattern, question trends, and crucial concepts. Carefully designed, it provides a strategic edge with comprehensive solutions to the UPPSC previous years' papers and engaging solved mock papers. Each solution comes with clear explanations, helping you grasp the fundamental concepts better and sharpening your problem-solving abilities.

author: R Rajagopalan
author_bio:
Prof R Rajagopalan

	He has published over 25 books on environment for schools, colleges, and the general public.

Complete Guide on the subject for the Civil Services Preliminary and Main Examinations as well as the Indian Forest Service Examination.

Online Support

•	Dynamic sets of Mock tests

title: Indian Geography Through Maps
author: Somesh Kumar Upadhyay
author_bio: Somesh Kumar Upadhyay is an Indian Administrative Service officer of the 2017 batch currently serving as the Collector & DM of Deogarh district in Odisha. He has a master’s degree in biology (by Research) from the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Mumbai and a BSc (Hons) degree in Microbiology from St. Xavier’s College, Kolkata. He has also qualified in the UGC-NET examination. Geography has been his favourite subject since school, and it was his optional subject in the UPSC CSE 2016 examination where he secured AIR 34.
subject: Academic
description:
Indian Geography Through Maps, Second Edition is a comprehensive book on the subject specifically designed for the aspirants of Civil Services examination. It will also be useful for those appearing in various State Services examinations.
The book will help the aspirants to discover the vibrant tapestry of India's geography through maps. This edition provides latest data points sourced from government reports. To ensures clarity, the maps have been updated and illustrated.
A first-of-its-kind attempt, this book presents information with brevity and simplicity to aid preparation for the Civil Services examination.
Key Features
•	With More than 100 Maps and Diagrams
•	Solved Previous Years’ Prelims Papers (2014-2023)
•	Unsolved Previous Years‘ Papers for Geography Optional and GS 1
•	(2014-2023)
•	Updated data and figures

title: Corporate Law Referencer
author: Sumit Pahwa
author_bio: eMinds Legal is a boutique Corporate Law Firm based in Gurgaon, India, specializing in Corporate Secretarial, Corporate Legal, Compliance, Accounting & Payroll. The firm comprises of a team of around 40+ professionals with in-depth subject matter knowledge and Partners having industry experience of over 20 years each. Dr Sumit Pahwa, Partner, eMinds Legal is the lead author of the book. A Corporate Lawyer & Company Secretary, Sumit is the Co-founder of Complinity - Governance, Risk and Compliance Software. Sumit has over 20 years of experience and is an expert in Corporate Laws, Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), and Cyber. Sumit regularly appears before the benches of National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) in relation to IBC, shareholder disputes and other matters.
subject: Law
description: Corporate Law Referencer presents a 360o view of the Companies Act, 2013 and Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008 with section-wise arrangement of all Circulars, Orders, Rules & Notifications including Procedures, FAQs, Resolutions, Adjudication Orders and Judicial Precedents.

title: India’s Odyssey: From a Developing Country to an Emerging Superpower
author: Pratap Singh
author_bio: Pratap Singh is an IRS officer with elaborate experience in tax policy formulation and administration over the last 32 years. During his career, he has assumed significant roles in the Government of India and has served at different locations including Delhi, Bangalore, Mumbai, and Gurgaon. He is also the author of the book Reforms in Tax Administration: An Indian Experience, and has written research papers. Mr Singh’s expertise has resulted in several amendments in the Income Tax laws.
subject: Business & General
description:
As India embarks on its journey to becoming a developed economy, its developmental odyssey serves as an inspiration and offers time-tested nuggets for aspiring nations striving for all-round progress. India’s Odyssey: From a Developing Country to an Emerging Superpower dives deep into this transformational journey of India — Bharata from its great ancient civilisation to the dark ages of subjugation, followed by its progression into a developing country towards an emerging superpower. The last three decades have seen remarkable changes in India, evident by its modern economy, excellent infrastructure, and an exceptional scientific innovation ecosystem. Armed with a strong military and its ranking as the fifth-largest economy in the world, India radiates confidence in its progress and growth.

The book covers the political journey of the country and important events since Independence. India is already at the cusp of becoming the third largest economy. The author has attempted to capture the holistic economic development of the country that focuses on building a modern and low carbon economy. Recent geopolitical developments and events shaping India and the world right from G-20, BRICS, SCO, QUAD, Ukraine war to Israel-Hamas conflict and other important developments, have also been examined.

title: Compulsory English
author: A P Bharadwaj
author_bio: A P BHARDWAJ is a well-known name, and an established author of #1 NATIONAL BESTSELLER COMPULSORY ENGLISH for IAS (MAINS) for more than a decade. He has authored more than ten books. He has single-handedly trained and tutored innumerable students to get admission into national law universities and colleges and is known as CLAT GURU. He has also trained and enabled numerous students to score well in English and essay papers in civil and judicial services examinations. He is popular in the tri-city of Chandigarh- Mohali-Panchkula as an ELT expert.
subject: Academic
description:
With a distinguished track record of 14 years as #1 NATIONAL BESTSELLER, A P Bhardwaj’s COMPULSORY ENGLISH 5th Edition has been completely revised and revamped, featuring section-wise solved papers of IAS (MAINS) 2023. This new edition brings: 
•	Updated sections covering Grammar, Vocabulary, and Composition, incorporating the 2023 IAS paper with answers
•	Revised and refined chapters on Punctuation, Precis, and Common Errors (now expanded to 1200)
•	Enhanced vocabulary section, now comprising 2000 words with meanings and usage
•	Inclusion of 3000 synonyms and antonyms, along with clarification on 600 commonly confusing words and substitution for 1000 words
•	Incorporation of 525 distinguished idioms with meanings and usage, as well as exploration of 100 words used in different forms

title: Capital Taxation Law and Practice
author: P V Srinivasan
author_bio:
P V Srinivasan is a Corporate Advisor on Global Tax and Corporate Laws. He served as the Head of Corporate Tax in Wipro Limited, Bangalore for 18 years and has 40 years of
hands-on experience in global corporate tax compliance including the US, Europe, India and Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, addressing structuring requirements, cross-border business re-organizations, transfer pricing, IPRs taxation, employees’ taxation, indirect taxes and EU VAT, social security taxes, etc. He has secured landmark judgements on tax matters from courts in India and overseas. He has successfully represented and concluded tax assessments in the USA, Germany, Japan, the UK etc. He has rendered advocacy to Central and State Governments in India and Governments of foreign countries on tax and corporate regulatory matters.
subject: Tax
description:
Capital Taxation: Law and Practice is an exhaustive commentary on the subject, offering an in-depth analysis of the concept and regulatory framework governing the taxation of capital in all its forms in India and other jurisdictions across the globe.
Taxation of capital is older than the taxation of income. While the income of a fiscal year is often seen as an increase in wealth, capital taxation has sparked more controversy than other types of tax. Meagre revenue yields, the subjective base of the levy, unpredictability of the event of taxation are a few reasons for its repeated repeal and reintroduction. This is in addition to the traditional concerns of tax avoidance and a plethora of exemptions that are more pronounced in capital taxation. Nevertheless, several countries have capital taxation currently in force.
This book is divided into two parts, Part A deals with the genres of capital taxation, their salient features, the history and evolution of wealth transfer tax, and the design principles; and Part B covers capital taxation regimes in some of the other countries. Policymakers, academicians, tax practitioners, and high net worth individuals are sure to find the book handy.

The book showcases the role and contribution of the Court in endeavouring to make the constitutional vision a reality, fostering a constitutional culture, and enforcing checks and balances within the constitutional framework, as well as examining some of the infirmities in its judgments. A critical appraisal of the Court’s work is essential for presenting a true and coherent picture of the law.

author_bio:
कामना सिंह, वर्तमान में राज्य कर अधिकारी, उत्तर प्रदेश के पद पर नियुक्त हैं। इनका चयन उत्तर प्रदेश लोक सेवा आयोग द्वारा आयोजित पीएससी परीक्षा 2016 में हुआ। लेखिका को आईएएस एवं विभिन्न राज्यों की पीएससी परीक्षायें देने का अनुभव रहा है। इसके पूर्व इन्हें 10 वर्षों का विभिन्न सरकारी एवं प्राइवेट सिविल सर्विस कोचिंग संस्थानों में अभ्यर्थियों को सिविल सेवा के लिए मार्गदर्शन देने का अनुभव रहा है तथा इनके निर्देशन में अनेक अभ्यर्थियों ने आईएएस एवं पीएससी जैसी परीक्षाओं में उच्च स्थान प्राप्त किया है।

वैभव कुमार, वर्तमान में सिविल सेवा प्रशिक्षक एवं मार्गदर्शक के रूप में विभिन्न अभ्यर्थियों का मार्गदर्शन एवं निर्देशन कर रहे हैं। इन्होने आईएएस एवं विभिन्न पीएससी परीक्षाओं में प्री एवं मेन्स की परीक्षायें उत्तीर्ण की हैं तथा हिंदी साहित्य, राजनीति विज्ञान एवं समाज कार्य जैसे विषयों का गहन अध्ययन किया है तथा स्नातकोत्तर उपाधियाँ प्राप्त की हैं।

•	UPPSC द्वारा जारी नवीन पाठ्यक्रम पर आधारित सरल, सुबोध और सुगम्य भाषा में लिखी पुस्तक है। नवीन पाठ्यक्रम में दिये गये विषयों को समसामयिक मुद्दों से अंतर्संबंध करना।
•	उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार के द्वारा संचालित नीतियों, योजनाओं, परियोजनाओं का यथा सम्भव स्थान पर समावेश किया गया है।
•	फ्लोचार्ट, तालिकाओं, चित्रों का प्रयोग, जिन्हें उत्तर लेखन में प्रयुक्त किया जा सकता है।
•	यूपीपीएससी 2023 मुख्य परीक्षा (सामान्य अध्ययन पेपर-6) के मॉडल उत्तर की प्रस्तुति।

title: Practitioner’s Guide to International Family Law
author: Anil Malhotra and Ankit Malhotra
author_bio:
Anil Malhotra is a practising Advocate with over 40 years of experience with expertise on implementation, interpretation, and application of Foreign Court Orders regarding divorce decrees, child abduction, custody, maintenance, adoption, surrogacy and family related issues of Non-resident Indians (NRIs). Anil has co-authored several books on diverse subjects. He is a regular speaker at international and domestic conferences and has over 500 newspaper columns to his credit besides contributing articles in reputed Family Law Journals. He is a Member of the International Academy of Family Lawyers since 2007 and its Child Relocation Committee. He completed B.Sc. (1980) and LL.B (Professional) (1983) degrees from Panjab University & an LLM degree from the University of London in 1985. He studied Comparative Family Law at LSE besides Law & Society at SOAS, University of London.

Ankit Malhotra read his B.A. and LL.B from O.P. Jindal Global University. He was awarded, from 2017-2022, Best Student Researcher, Rank 1 for Outstanding Contribution to Academic Initiatives, Outstanding All-Round Performance and a Gold Medal in Recognition of Outstanding Performance and Certificate for Outstanding Leadership. In 2022-2023, as the Felix Scholar, he read his LLM in International Law at the School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London. Mr. Malhotra has worked in the Chambers of Justice A.K. Sikri and since then has assisted in rendering expert reports and assistance in cases to domestic and foreign courts on recognition of foreign orders, international abduction, and the nuances of Private and Public International Family Law issues from an Indian perspective.
subject: Law
description:
Practitioner’s Guide to International Family Law: An Indian Perspective is an authoritative and comprehensive resource that bridges the complexities of Indian family laws with the evolving challenges of international family law. Designed for practitioners, judges, academics, and students, the book addresses key issues such as cross-border marriage, divorce, child custody, maintenance, adoption, and the enforcement of foreign judgments and arbitral awards. It explores the interplay between Indian personal laws—covering Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Parsi, and secular legal frameworks like the Special Marriage Act—and international legal instruments, including the Hague Conventions and other bilateral treaties governing family law.

The book provides in-depth guidance on jurisdictional dilemmas, forum shopping, conflict of laws, and the recognition of foreign decrees under Indian law, highlighting critical provisions and contemporary case law. The book highlights significant judicial interpretations and landmark decisions, ensuring readers remain updated with the latest legal developments. By bridging domestic family law with international instruments, treaties, and comparative case studies, the guide provides solutions to complex cross-border family disputes. Further focus is given to cases involving non-resident Indians, expatriates, and cross-border families, offering clarity on topics such as habitual residence, domicile, and the enforcement of maintenance and custody orders abroad. It presents a comparative analysis of legal systems to equip readers with tools to address globalized family disputes effectively.

With its focus on harmonizing domestic and international legal principles, this guide also engages with contemporary challenges, including inter-country child abduction, international surrogacy agreements, and cross-border domestic violence. Written with procedural precision and supported by practical examples, updated citations, and legislative reforms, the book is a definitive tool for navigating international family law issues while considering India’s unique legal and cultural contexts. It is an essential reading for those seeking to understand and resolve complex, multi-jurisdictional family law matters in an increasingly interconnected and legally pluralistic world.

title: AI on Trial
author: Sujeet Kumar and Md Tauseef Alam
author_bio:
Sujeet Kumar is a Member of Parliament (MP) in the Rajya Sabha, representing the state of Odisha. He was one of the youngest MPs to head the Petitions Committee of Rajya Sabha. An Engineer turned Lawyer, he is currently practising law at the Supreme Court of India, various High Courts and Tribunals. He is the founder and Managing Partner of LexMantra. Previously, he worked at the World Economic Forum (WEF) in Geneva, Switzerland, and for United Nations Development Program (UNDP) and for Infosys Technologies Ltd. in India.

Md. Tauseef Alam is a law student at the Lloyd School of Law. Currently, he assists Shri Sujeet Kumar as his Legislative and Public Policy Associate, and Trainee Associate at LexMantra. Previously he has contributed by assisting Sr. Adv. Salman Khurshid, in prominent constitutional matters of AMU Minority Status and SC/ST Reservation. He has also assisted the Hon’ble Chief Justice, Calcutta High Court; Delhi Commission for Child Rights; Sr. Adv. SV Raju, Additional Solicitor General for India et al.
subject: Law
description:
AI on Trial is a forward-looking and probably the first of its kind project that examines the nexus between AI and legal systems, underlining the pressing requirement for obligation, culpability, and systems of governance. The book carefully covers AI’s key principles, culpability assignment, and legal hurdles throughout seven chapters.

In a nutshell, it analyzes biases in AI, basic rights, and the intricacies of intellectual property concerns of AI-generated content, suggesting solutions such as a “Machine-Created Intellectual Assets Act”. The book analyzes AI’s legal personhood, intentionality, and agency, calling on the Turing Test and international approaches. It also addresses models of civil and criminal liability, intermediary duties, and concerns connected to product liability.

A significant chapter oﬀers the idea of ‘safe harbour’ for AI, examining its repercussions for innovation and governance. The book finishes by examining AI’s influence on key fields such as healthcare and free speech, supporting equitable and balanced regulation.

title: Boss vs Coach: Transforming your Leadership Style
author: Mohit Khullar and Olivia Gadd
author_bio:
Mohit Khullar is a dynamic leader with over 23 years of experience in senior management roles spanning Risk and Quality, Consulting, and Strategy. An EMCC-accredited coach and thought leader, Mohit is passionate about transforming leadership paradigms to meet the demands of an ever-evolving world. His celebrated ‘Boss vs Coach’ series on LinkedIn has become a cornerstone for driving meaningful conversations around leadership evolution, inspiring professionals globally to adopt coaching-style leadership. Beyond his corporate endeavors, Mohit is an accomplished writer and poet.

Olivia Gadd is the co-founder of Big Thinking Space, an exciting global venture to bring coaching and coaching skills to a wider audience. As master coach and seasoned trainer she has worked with boards, owners and leaders to help them define success for themselves and their organisations. Her drive and purpose is to help people find self-determination by working on beliefs, thinking and behaviours to find energy and joy. Her clients range from sole traders to corporate CEOs; from people managing changes to those aiming to improve the status quo.
subject: Business & General
description: In the rapidly evolving landscape of modern business, the shift from control to empowerment is not merely a managerial preference but a strategic imperative. The traditional boss, anchored in authority and micromanagement, may achieve compliance but often at the expense of innovation and engagement. In contrast, the coach understands that empowering team members unleashes their potential, drives creativity, and foster a resilient organizational culture. The book discusses key concepts and tools that the readers can utilise to start their journey of transformation from being a boss to a coach. The book will be of value to mid level managers, business leaders, management scholars, and everyone aspiring to elevate their leadership game.

author: K K Khandelwal
author_bio: Dr K K Khandelwal, is a former Indian civil servant, engineer, legal expert, author, and academician. Prior to this, he held the position of Chairman of the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority in Gurugram. Dr K K Khandelwal's contributions span across his roles in civil service, academia, and legal literature. His work, particularly in the field of real estate regulation and scout leadership, alongside his academic contributions, has been widely recognized. His interdisciplinary research and publications reflect his broad range of academic pursuits and professional engagements.
subject: Law
description:
Insight into Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: A Paradigm Shift in Indian Penal Law is a comprehensive guide, providing an indispensable insight into the new legal framework. Discover the reforms introduced by the BNS, which aims to align the law with current societal values, technological advancements, and a victim-centric approach. This book meticulously dissects the provisions of the BNS, offering a clear understanding of the streamlined legal framework.

Gain a deeper understanding of
• Key changes and their implications, including the incorporation of contemporary issues like cybercrime and enhanced focus on gender justice.
• Comparative analysis with the IPC, highlighting the legislative intent and practical implications of the new code.
• The revised definitions of offences such as sedition and defamation, and the enhanced penalties for crimes against women and children.
• The inclusion of new offences like mob lynching and terrorism, and the revised approach to organised crime and public safety violations.
• The abolition of outdated provisions and the introduction of community service as a new form of punishment.
• The expansion of definitions to include economic and intangible assets as movable property.
• Detailed discussions supported by relevant case law and judicial precedents.

This book serves as a practical resource for judges, legal practitioners, enforcement officers, scholars, and students.
